function.arguments: {"decision": "accept", "reason": "Request maps to the allowed upward_reserve_sizing task with supported region CISO, supported horizon 120 minutes, and supported shortfall cost 10.0 (cost_reserve=1.0). The operator's note that solar drop-off is already reflected in the observed ramp is consistent with using only issue-time observed information (observed_weather, recent_ramp, lagged_load, load_statistics, calendar, current_load, horizon, region_id, cost_ratio). The observed solar drop-off is treated as part of the observed ramp rather than as a future-information input.
